criterion: Criterion 5. The answer tells the reader that the post-mortem note and the CRM record disagree about when the complaint was raised: it names the disagreement, or calls the note's October date wrong or loosely recalled, or says that no October complaint exists in the system. Answer no if the answer never compares the two dates at all, or if it silently picks one and leaves the reader unaware there was a conflict. It does not matter which words carry the finding, whether it is split over several sentences, or which language it is in.
answer:
Reply Deutschland, valantic AG and Körber Digital all raised it.

The post-mortem note dated 3 Dec 2025 says the customer complained in October. Die Nachbesprechung vom 03.12.2025 sagt, der Kunde habe sich im Oktober erneut beschwert.

The record says otherwise: the only complaint on Reply is an inbound e-mail of 18 September 2025, so the note contradicts the timeline the CRM holds. Either an October escalation was never logged, or the note is recalling the date loosely.
